# Hermit CRM

> A free, open-source CRM for founders, freelancers and anyone doing their own sales. It keeps your companies, contacts and conversations as plain text files on your laptop, and your own AI agent can reshape it to fit how you work. With a pipeline, a calendar, dashboards and enrichment from a company's website.

Hermit CRM is a free, open-source CRM for founders, freelancers and anyone doing their own sales. It runs on your Mac or Linux computer and keeps every company, contact and conversation as a Markdown file in a git folder on your own disk. A local web app gives you a pipeline board, a calendar of next steps, message drafts and reports. AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Claude Desktop can read and update the pipeline through the files, a small CLI or the built-in MCP server. It is alpha software under the Apache License 2.0, with no warranty and no support.

## Make it yours, with your own AI

Say what you want in one sentence. Your own AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI) builds it in your data folder, following recipes that come with Hermit, and you see it on the next page load.

- A dashboard from one sentence: "Make a dashboard called Monday review with my open deals, what is due this week and the deals by stage with their value. Pin it to the sidebar." One new file, dashboards/monday-review.toml. The page is pinned in the sidebar, and every number opens the records behind it.
- A new field: "Add a date field contract renewal to companies, shown on the company page and in the companies list." Seven lines in fields.toml. The field shows on every company page, and as a column you can sort and filter in the companies list.
- A routine that drafts follow-ups: "Every morning, for people I messaged 7 days ago without a reply, draft a short follow-up. Never send anything." A routine in routines.toml. It starts paused, so you see first who it would pick. Once you turn it on, its drafts wait on Home for you to edit and send yourself.

Safe to try. Every change is a git commit you can undo in one click. Routines only write drafts: they start paused, and Hermit never sends a message.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hermitcrm.io/): what it is, how to install it, questions and answers
- [Hermit CRM compared](https://hermitcrm.io/compare/): How Hermit CRM, a free local CRM for one person, compares with HubSpot, Attio, Pipedrive, folk, Twenty and Notion on price, data and AI access.

## Comparisons

- [Hermit CRM vs HubSpot](https://hermitcrm.io/compare/hubspot/): Choose HubSpot if a team shares the CRM, or if you want marketing, sales and service in one hosted platform. Choose Hermit CRM if you sell on your own, want your pipeline as plain files on your own computer, and want AI tools such as Claude Code to work on it directly. Hermit CRM is free; HubSpot is free for up to 2 users, and its paid plans are priced per seat.
- [Hermit CRM vs Attio](https://hermitcrm.io/compare/attio/): Choose Attio if a small team shares the CRM, or you want your own objects and records built automatically from your mailbox and calendar. Choose Hermit CRM if you work alone and want your pipeline as plain files on your own computer, readable by any AI tool without an API key. Hermit CRM is free; Attio is free for up to 3 seats, and paid plans start at €31 a seat a month.
- [Hermit CRM vs Pipedrive](https://hermitcrm.io/compare/pipedrive/): Choose Pipedrive if you run a sales team, want automations and email sequences, or need a mobile app. Choose Hermit CRM if you sell on your own, want a pipeline board without a subscription, and want the data as plain files on your own computer that AI tools can read. Hermit CRM is free; Pipedrive has a 14-day trial and starts at €14 a seat a month billed yearly.
- [Hermit CRM vs folk](https://hermitcrm.io/compare/folk/): Choose folk if you work with a small team, manage many relationships and want contacts enriched and captured from LinkedIn and your mailbox for you. Choose Hermit CRM if you work alone and want your companies, contacts and conversations as plain files on your own computer, with AI tools reading them directly. Hermit CRM is free; folk has a 14-day trial and starts at €22 a member a month billed yearly.
- [Hermit CRM vs Twenty](https://hermitcrm.io/compare/twenty/): Both are open source. Choose Twenty if a team shares the CRM and you can run a server with Docker, or want its hosted cloud. Choose Hermit CRM if you work alone and want the CRM on your own laptop, with no server and no database: every record is a Markdown file in git that you and your AI tools can read.
- [Hermit CRM vs Notion](https://hermitcrm.io/compare/notion/): Choose Notion if you already work in Notion, share it with others, and a database with a board view is all the CRM you need. Choose Hermit CRM if you want a CRM that does CRM work for you: mail logged on the right contact by BCC, a follow-up radar for unanswered threads, meeting briefs and reports, with the data as plain files on your own computer. Both are free for one person.

## Facts

- Price for one person: Free and open source. There is no paid plan.
- Where your data lives: In a folder on your own computer.
- Data format: Markdown files with YAML front matter: one per company, contact and conversation. Readable without the app.
- Works offline: Yes. It runs on your computer. Mail import, enrichment and Ask Hermit need the internet.
- Team use: No. It is built for one person.
- AI tools: Your AI tool reads the files, runs the CLI or connects to the local MCP server. No API key, no OAuth. Ask Hermit uses the AI command line tool you already have.
- Email and calendar: BCC or forward mail to a Gmail address you choose, and it is logged on the right contact. Past meetings come from your calendar's ICS link. No inbox sync.
- History and undo: Every change is a git commit, so every earlier version is kept and can be restored.
- Source code: Open source, Apache License 2.0.
- Runs on: macOS and Linux, in your browser. No Windows and no mobile app.
- Setup: Download it and let your AI coding tool install it. It needs Python 3.11 and git and installs them when they are missing.
- Maturity and support: Alpha software. No warranty and no support.
